bugs.criterion: Scan flow supports image/demo entry, processing state, and annotated compliance results
bugs.evidence: Named browser check scan-results failed twice: after clicking demo-scan-button, data-testid=processing-title was not observable within 5s because the seeded API fallback completed before the processing panel could render. The backend create flow is healthy (test_tscheck_scan_flow.py passed; POST /api/compliance/scans returned 200 with six declarations). This makes the required Extracting declarations... state effectively unobservable to users in the fast seeded-demo path.

action_items: Make the processing state observable for a short minimum duration or provide an explicit processing transition before the demo response resolves.
Authentication is intentionally a DEMO role selector; no real login was tested.
PDF and DOCX exports are intentionally MOCK downloadable blobs per the prototype specification.
